question.text: A person standing on the bank of a river observes that the angle of elevation of the top of a tree on the opposite bank of the river is $60^{\circ}$ and when he retires 40 meter away from the tree the angle of elevation becomes $30^{\circ}$. The breadth of the river is

solution.text: $\tan 30^{\circ}=\frac{h}{40+b}$ $\Rightarrow \sqrt{3} h=40+b$ $\tan 60^{\circ}=h / b \Rightarrow h=\sqrt{3} b$ $\Rightarrow b=20 m$
